# laravelforge_server_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH key authorized on a Laravel Forge server. SSH keys are immutable: any change forces replacement (the Forge API offers no update endpoint).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the SSH key.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `public_key` (String) The public key contents. Write-only on create; not returned by the API on read.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to add the SSH key to.
- `username` (String) System user the key is installed for (e.g. `forge`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the SSH key.
- `status` (String) Installation status.
